analysis_role: offline observational mechanism diagnostic; no causal claim or experiment

time_and_event_rules.scored_samples: exact existing full72 grid t=0.000..19.999 s at 1 kHz; t=20 terminal excluded
time_and_event_rules.blocks: 20 half-open blocks [j,j+1), j=0..19; each has exactly 1000 scored samples
time_and_event_rules.source_target_pairs: source j=0..18 only; target j+1=1..19; no overlap in source-derived predictor and target interval
time_and_event_rules.source_phase: early j=0..9; late j=10..18; phase is determined by predictor/source block
time_and_event_rules.events: event flag indices are exactly 10,20,...,19990 (0-based); event times exactly 0.01..19.99 s; only valid inference events enter projections

predictor.residual: logged applied_output - beta*clip(Y,-3,3), same-event world/inertial coordinates, m/s^2
predictor.event_projection: residual dot dAtt / norm(dAtt), m/s^2; equal-weight mean over valid source-block events
predictor.near_zero_rule: exclude event when norm(dAtt) <= 1.0e-12 m/s^2; count exclusions; no imputation
predictor.reconstruction_check: per-scene 3D target RMS and online residual RMS/axis RMS must match the audited full72 mechanism table within 1e-12 m/s^2

outcome_and_model.z_rmse: sqrt(mean((logged state z - reference z)^2)) on the same 1000 aligned full72 score timestamps per block
outcome_and_model.main_coefficient: projection beta is a conditional predictive association beyond current-block error and common source-block trend; units s^2
outcome_and_model.estimation: two-way FE OLS; 2000 percentile bootstrap replicates resampling entire scene clusters; duplicate draws receive distinct scene FE IDs; seed 2026102201
outcome_and_model.interval_rule: report CI only for strata with >=20 independent scenes; 5..19 scene point estimates are descriptive only; this threshold does not guarantee generalization
outcome_and_model.posthoc_outcome_strata: candidate WIN/LOSS/TIE vs B uses full-horizon outcome and is exploratory only; outcome strata are produced within W09-W14
outcome_and_model.group_scope: overall and wind groups; task, source-phase and posthoc outcome strata within W09-W14 only
